name: n8n-nodes-jsonform
description: n8n trigger node that serves a JSONForms-based form rendered with shadcn/ui (via @fragno-dev/jsonforms-shadcn-renderers). Configure the form in the node UI or import a JSON config.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:node
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build && node scripts/place-web-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:node: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp nodes/JsonForm/jsonform.svg nodes/JsonForm/form.html dist/nodes/JsonForm/
